description:
Hi everyone! I’m Akhila, a third-year Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) student with strong skills in Python programming, data analytics, digital logic, and microcontroller interfacing. I’m passionate about building practical, innovative solutions that combine hardware, embedded systems, and data-driven software.
I’m looking to build a collaborative, well-rounded team focused on creating a clean, working prototype and delivering a strong final presentation
summary: Our project, Earth-Sun-Moon Simulation, is an interactive astronomical model designed to visualize and explain the orbital mechanics, relative motions, and celestial alignments of the Earth, Sun, and Moon. It works by simulating gravitational orbits and axial rotation in real time, allowing users to observe how these movements directly cause day-and-night cycles, seasons, lunar phases, and solar or lunar eclipses. Key Benefits & Intended For this project, we developed an interactive Earth awareness and sustainability platform designed to help users understand our planet's ecosystems and track environmental health. Many people lack accessible, easy-to-understand insights into how daily human activities affect Earth's climate, biodiversity, and natural resources. Our project addresses this challenge by simplifying complex environmental data into clear visual metrics and offering practical, everyday eco-friendly actions. This initiative is important because protecting Earth requires collective, informed participation; by bridging the gap between raw environmental science and daily habits, our platform empowers individuals and communities to actively reduce their ecological footprint and contribute to a healthier, more sustainable planet.
